scenarios.reasoning: The agent demonstrated competent use of the binlog tools and produced a well-formatted, organized output. However, it got the central finding wrong — it claimed LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution when the correct answer is that it was not included in the solution build. This fundamental error cascaded: the agent couldn't identify the configuration mismatch or connect the dots to the actual root cause (project not in solution → wrong config → wrong output path). The presentation is polished but the analysis is incorrect on the key questions asked.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
